pinterest.title: Elounda and Agios Nikolaos: Crete Wedding Venues With Private Chapels and Bay Views
pinterest.description: East Crete is resort country on Mirabello Bay. Elounda Beach has a private chapel and seats 430 for a banquet outdoors at Artemis. St. Nicolas Bay holds ceremonies on the deck of its beachside chapel, and Elounda Peninsula, Porto Elounda and Elounda Mare share one weddings team, so you can marry at one and stay at another. Guests fly into Heraklion: Minos Beach and Minos Palace are about 50 minutes away. Compare 15 Crete wedding venues by area.

pinterest.title: Chania Wedding Venues: Crete Wedding Venues for 30 to 680 Guests in the West
pinterest.description: West Crete suits both the largest and the most personal weddings. Avra Imperial at Kolymvari has the private chapel of Saint Paul and an events hall for up to 680. Euphoria Resort sizes its packages for up to 30 guests. Sea View by En Kipo, a hilltop garden in Chania, seats 120 and is yours alone from 10am until midnight. Book guests into Chania Airport, not Heraklion. Compare 15 Crete wedding venues.

pinterest.title: Crete Wedding Venues for Every Ceremony: Civil, Greek Orthodox or Symbolic
pinterest.description: Symbolic weddings and vow renewals are not legally recognised in Greece, so a legal marriage needs a civil or religious ceremony with the paperwork behind it. Nana Princess in Hersonissos offers all three: civil weddings on its private beach, Greek Orthodox weddings in the Chapel of St. George, and symbolic ceremonies. In July and August it recommends a ceremony from 6.30pm to 8pm because of the heat. Plan documents weeks ahead.

slides: 15 Crete wedding venues, east to west. Pick the area before the venue: it decides which airport your guests land at.
Elounda and Agios Nikolaos: resort country on Mirabello Bay. Elounda Beach has a private chapel and seats 430 for a banquet outdoors at Artemis.
Hersonissos and the Heraklion coast: the shortest drives from Heraklion. Amirandes is 18 km from the airport and hosts celebrations of up to 300.
Rethymno: a medieval town and the Fortezza. Caramel sits minutes away, where sea turtles nest on the beach below the gardens.
Chania and the west: Avra Imperial has an events hall for up to 680, while Sea View by En Kipo is a hilltop garden for 120 that is yours alone for the day.
Summer heat sets the ceremony time. Nana Princess recommends 4pm to 6pm in April, May and October, and 6.30pm to 8pm in July and August.
Symbolic weddings are not legally recognised in Greece. For a legal marriage, plan a civil or religious ceremony and prepare documents weeks ahead.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Which Crete wedding venues suit your guest list?

Crete has more than 1,000 km of coastline, so the drive from the plane to the party is part of the choice. Start with three questions: how many guests you are inviting, which kind of ceremony you want, and which airport those guests will land at.

Our new guide sets out 15 venues across four areas, from Elounda and Agios Nikolaos in the east to Chania in the west, with the same details for every one: ceremony on site, largest published capacity, rooms and exclusive use.

The short version: fly guests into Heraklion for the east and centre, and into Chania for the west. Choose an evening ceremony as summer heats up. Ask each venue whether exclusive use means a chosen space or the whole hotel, and get the curfew, minimum nights and rain plan in writing before you pay a deposit.

Shortlisting Crete venues for your own wedding? Send us a message with your date, guest count and the venues you have in mind, and a Wedded Advisor will help you compare them. Your advisor works in your time zone and quotes in AUD. Full guide at the link in our bio.
